essence: The self is self-luminous consciousness (caitanya), identical with supreme Śiva, and its recognition dissolves all bondage and duality.
Bondage is knowing-as-limited; recognition alone removes it.
How threefold impurity binds is the question.
Mātṛkā is both binder and foundation.
Therefore sudden bhairava surge, intensified by reflection and practice, becomes absorption that ends ignorance bondage.
